text:
Elaine: Thanks for coming to the all-hands. A few folks asked for clearer timing on API / Console / Optimize so leadership asked me to open this follow-up thread to capture exact launch windows, owners, and any blockers. @Kyle can you start with the API roadmap?
Kyle: Sure — quick summary: API public GA (stable billing + SLAs) target is 'early Q3'. Beta for structured output & tool-calling is already rolled to selected customers. Remaining work: SLA legal signoffs, infra burst capacity testing, and docs. Owner: Sophia. Blockers: a small set of request-rate edgecases in gateway that Miguel is triaging.
Sophia: Confirming — GA window = early Q3 (conservative: 6–8 weeks from today). We need final pricing guidance from finance and one more week of customer canary results to be comfortable. I can consolidate a single checklist doc. Link: https://redwood-internal.company/roadmaps/api-ga (internal).
Miguel: Gateway rps flap — reproducer in staging under long-poll streaming. Root cause looks like a race in the token bucket when batching mix is at 50/50 sync/stream. I'm landing a fix in staging today; if tests pass we'll promote tomorrow. Perf regression is <5% when batching is enabled.
Dave: From runtime side, we still need to validate canary on Dedicated for p99 tail. If Miguel's fix arrives tomorrow we can run the Dedicated canary Thursday and validate GPU scheduling knobs. Owner: Dave + Eng-runtime.
Robin: Console question — what's the Console GA definition here? Is it feature-complete vs. incremental? We heard "iterative GA" last call.
Sophia: Console: goal is "GA for core workflows" by mid-Q3 (dashboards, per-route model config, rollout UI). Advanced features (optimize recommendations, quantization UI) are slated for Q4. So it's staged: core console mid-Q3, advanced console Q4. Owner: Robin for shipping cadence.
Elaine: Good, that matches leadership intent — core console mid-Q3 to give teams a single place for rollouts and observability. Optimize toolkit (cost/perf recommendations) should not block API/Console GA.
Miguel: Quick ask for leadership: can we defer one noncritical console integration (third-party APM link) to Q4 if it helps hit the mid-Q3 window?
Kyle: Yes, defer nonblocking integrations. Focus scope on what directly unblocks customers and SLAs.
Sophia: Optimize (the recommendations engine) — target for public beta late-Q3, GA in Q4. We need a few more production evals and a small UI to show cost impact along with suggested knobs. Owner: Sophia + Research/Optimize team. Blockers: eval coverage and a small infra quota change for per-tenant batch experiments.
Dave: Ops note: rollout plan for API GA will use a 10%->50%->100% ramp with automatic rollback on error spikes. We'll share canary metrics thresholds.
Elaine: Action items I tracked: 1) Sophia to publish consolidated checklist and final owner list by EOD tomorrow; 2) Miguel to land gateway fix and report staging results; 3) Dave to run Dedicated p99 canary once fix is in; 4) Robin to scope console MVP and confirm what's deferrable; 5) Kyle to confirm finance pricing cadence. Please add to the shared doc and ping me if dates slip. :pray:
Robin: I'll add Console scope and mark the APM integration as deferred.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap sync scheduled Thu 09:00 PT.
Sophia: I'll drop the checklist link here once it's ready and tag owners. Expect it by EOD tomorrow. :point_down:
